Get RV Rental Pricing & Availability
 
RV Rentals | El Monte RV | Explore America
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

All bookings include:

Free Miles

Guests traveling from Canada to the USA receive complimentary mileage with their booking, with free mileage allowances ranging from 200 to 1,600 miles, depending on the relocation route.

VIP Coverage

VIP Coverage reduces the renter's responsibility for covered vehicle damages to $1,500, and protection for covered mechanical breakdowns.

Primary Third Party Insurance

Provides state minimum liability coverage for third-party claims if you get in an accident.

How Cross-Border Works

Picking Up

CanaDream offers scheduled pick-up times for RV Rentals. At pick-up, you'll sign all necessary documents and be given any extra helpful information for route!

Crossing the Border

You must have proper documentation for all travelers: passports, NEXUS cards, or Enhanced Driver’s Licenses are accepted. Bring RV registration and insurance papers too!

If you are a non-US citizen, you will be asked on outbound plans from the U.S. while crossing the border.

Dropping Off

Our staff at El Monte RV will be ready to welcome you at drop-off! Standard drop-off hours are 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM, and upon return, if the RV is in good condition, your security deposit will be released!

Important: U.S. Vehicle Import Requirement

This relocation special requires you to import the vehicle into the United States on behalf of CanaDream.

As part of the relocation, you must:

  • Cross into the U.S. at your pre-selected approved commercial border crossing.
  • Use the commercial crossing/inspection area, not the regular passenger vehicle lane.
  • Present the vehicle import documents provided at pick-up and have them stamped by U.S. border officials.
  • Pay the applicable $21 USD border fee.

Your selected border crossing cannot be changed once the import paperwork has been submitted.

By confirming this reservation, you acknowledge that completing the required U.S. vehicle import process is a condition of this relocation special.

Please note this rental is crossing an international border. As part of the border crossing process, you will be required to submit paperwork to authorities. We will provide all required support materials before travel. To ensure we can support you during the process, all border crossing should be planned for a weekday.

Weather dependent, the vehicle may be winterized at pick-up to protect the water line system. This means there will be no access to any of the water features in the vehicle. If travelling to a warmer drop off location, you may choose to de-winterize the RV at your own cost and own risk. We ask that you plan your trip accordingly.

Please review our Winterization Policy here: Winterization | El Monte RV

 

Two Brands, One Company

CanaDream and El Monte RV are two proud brands united under the global motorhome leader, Tourism Holdings Ltd (thl), delivering unforgettable RV experiences across North America. With CanaDream celebrating 30 years of innovation and guest-focused service in Canada—and El Monte’s 50-year legacy of excellence in the U.S., we both share a commitment to quality, adventure, and hospitality. 

Together, we offer travelers the freedom to explore at their own pace, backed by decades of expertise and a passion for the open road.

Book your roadtrip!

A new way to explore North America

CanaDream and El Monte RV

CanaDream and El Monte RV have teamed up to offer limited-time one-way RV relocation specials starting at just $1/night for the first 7 nights, then $99/night thereafter. 

Available on Mighty D and Mighty T motorhomes, these relocation offers include VIP and Personal Liability Coverage (PLC), and generous mileage allowances on select routes. 

Pick-up is now between October 15 30 and November 30, 2026, and experience an unforgettable North American road trip at an exceptional value.

About CanaDream

CanaDream is one of Canada's leading RV rental and sales companies, offering high-quality vehicles for travelers to explore the country at their own pace. Founded in 1994, the company has grown from a modest fleet to over 1,500 RVs across seven locations nationwide, celebrating its 30th anniversary in 2024! 

As part of the global tourism group thl, CanaDream connects guests to RV adventures not only in Canada but also in destinations like here in the US!

Learn More

Calgary to Denver

From our Calgary location, you will embark on an unforgettable road trip through Alberta’s iconic national parks—Banff, Jasper, and Yoho. These parks offer breathtaking scenery, abundant wildlife, and countless campgrounds, making it easy to experience Canada’s natural beauty at your own pace.

Canada to USA Relocation Specials

Toronto / Montreal to Orlando

From our Toronto location in Ontario, you'll find Niagara Falls, and our Montreal location in Quebec, is in Canada's largest province by area, and offers a lot to visitors to the region, both scenically and historically.

Take a Class C Medium or Large to our Orlando location.

Book Now

Toronto / Montreal to New York

From our Toronto location in Ontario, you'll find Niagara Falls, and our Montreal location in Quebec, is in Canada's largest province by area, and offers a lot to visitors to the region, both scenically and historically.

Finish your RV trip to our New York location!

Book Now

Vancouver to Los Angeles

Our Vancouver location in British Columbia, has highlights such as Barkerville, the Inside Passage, Wine Country, hot springs, culture and often offer glimpses of the Northern Lights!

Finish your RV trip to our Los Angeles location. Explore the natural wonders of the West Coast, before seeing the city highlights like the Hollywood Walk of Fame and the Santa Monica Pier!

Book Now

Vancouver to Seattle

Begin your adventure from our Vancouver location in beautiful British Columbia, where you can explore the rugged Pacific coastline, the scenic Sea-to-Sky Highway, world-class wineries, mountain landscapes, and charming coastal towns.

Finish your RV journey at our Seattle location in Washington, home to iconic attractions like the Space Needle, Pike Place Market, and the stunning Puget Sound.
